_meta.what: Printers whose support in Kiln is not the ordinary case: ones Kiln has no connection to yet, and ones added before any had been tried on real hardware.
_meta.why_public: A person setting up or asking about one of these has to be told with no record and no connection, on every plan.

states.not_driven: Kiln designs and slices for it and cannot connect to it; `start_with` says how its owner starts a print.
states.untested: Kiln connects to it the way it connects to its siblings, and that has not been tried on a real one.

_meta.rule: Keys are catalogue printer ids. A printer with no row is one Kiln drives; nothing here is carried to a sibling model.

anycubic_kobra_x.start_with: the maker's slicer, its app or a USB drive

elegoo_centauri_carbon_2.start_with: the maker's slicer or its app
